default.title: Work from anywhere
default.text: Join from any country where we can employ you, with core hours from 11:00 to 15:00 Toronto time.

default.title: Home office budget
default.text: CA$1,500 when you start and CA$500 every year after for a good chair, a better microphone or both.

default.title: Four weeks of focus time
default.text: On top of vacation: four meeting-free weeks a year to finish the work that needs deep attention.

default.title: Health cover
default.text: Health, dental and vision insurance for you and your family, or a stipend where private cover is not common.

default.title: Learning budget
default.text: CA$2,000 a year for courses, books and conferences, plus time to attend them.

default.title: Two retreats a year
default.text: The whole team meets in person twice a year. Past retreats: Lisbon, Montréal and Kyoto.
